item.title: LLM scraper bots are overloading acme.com's HTTPS server
item.description:
📝 I noticed some interesting things: Nearly all the incoming packets were web requests. Nearly all of them were for non-existent pages. Nearly all of them proudly announced in the user-agent that they were LLM scraper bots.
🔗 Read more: http://acme.com/updates/archive/229.html
